python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values exceeding 2400M for each year (Feb-Apr)
# 1972: 2405, 2401, 2401, 2401, 2402, 2401 = 6 bills
# 1973: 2402, 2402, 2403, 2401, 2401, 2401, 2402, 2401, 2401, 2402 = 10 bills (3/8 at 2391 and 3/22 at 2400 don't qualify)
# 1974: 2505, 2505, 2503, 2503, 2501, 2502, 2501, 2501, 2501, 2501, 2503, 2501 = 12 bills

values_1972 = [2405, 2401, 2401, 2401, 2402, 2401]
values_1973 = [2402, 2402, 2403, 2401, 2401, 2401, 2402, 2401, 2401, 2402]
values_1974 = [2505, 2505, 2503, 2503, 2501, 2502, 2501, 2501, 2501, 2501, 2503, 2501]

all_values = values_1972 + values_1973 + values_1974

print(f"1972 values (>{2400}M): {values_1972}")
print(f"Count: {len(values_1972)}")
print(f"1973 values (>{2400}M): {values_1973}")
print(f"Count: {len(values_1973)}")
print(f"1974 values (>{2400}M): {values_1974}")
print(f"Count: {len(values_1974)}")
print(f"Total count: {len(all_values)}")

# Calculate geometric mean
log_sum = sum(math.log(v) for v in all_values)
geo_mean = math.exp(log_sum / len(all_values))

print(f"\nGeometric mean: {geo_mean}")
print(f"Geometric mean rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(geo_mean, 2)}")

# Count - how many exceeded 2400M
count = len(all_values)
print(f"\nCount of bills exceeding $2400M: {count}")
EOF
